questions.scenario: You are scrolling through YouTube. Which video thumbnail makes you click immediately?

options.text: How a 21-year-old built a 1 Crore business.
How to build an AI chatbot with 10 lines of code.
The secret strategy behind passing new government laws.
A cheap way to save coastal cities from global warming.

questions.scenario: Your city is facing a huge water crisis. How would you solve it?

options.text: Become an IAS officer and fix the city's water management laws.
Build a smart sensor app that detects water leakage.
Start a water-purification startup to deliver clean water cheaply.
Form an NGO and teach every house rainwater harvesting.

questions.scenario: Your friends are terrified before an exam. How do you help them?

options.text: Calm them down and explain the concepts simply on a whiteboard.
Explain the deep scientific logic of why a formula works.
Look at their zodiac sign and confidently say, 'Your luck is great today!'
Motivate them like a leader and create a strict 2-hour study strategy.

questions.scenario: If you could sit in the chair of a top leader for one day, who would you choose?

options.text: A CEO of a massive tech giant like Google or Microsoft.
The National Security Advisor controlling the country's policies.
A top space scientist working on a Mars mission.
A top film director or media owner shaping what the country watches.

questions.scenario: You have to choose a topic for a mega school project. What do you pick?

options.text: Mental Health of Teenagers and how to prevent depression.
How to build a low-cost automated robot for Indian farmers.
Case Study: How India's biggest businesses make money.
Ancient Indian Astronomy, Vastu, and Vedic Sciences.

questions.scenario: What does a 'successful life' mean to you?

options.text: Bringing a massive positive change to the country, even if I stay unknown.
Holding a powerful position where my signature changes thousands of lives.
Building a massive financial empire and creating global wealth.
Sharing my knowledge and shaping the lives of thousands of students.

questions.scenario: It's the weekend. What kind of web series/movie do you prefer watching?

options.text: Deep sci-fi, space mysteries, or psychological thrillers.
Business, stock market, and corporate games (like Shark Tank).
Bureaucracy, intelligence agencies, and crime investigation.
Documentaries on wildlife, environment, or real-life heroes.

questions.scenario: When you meet a new person, what goes through your mind first?

options.text: I observe their body language and try to read their aura or vibe.
I listen carefully and try to understand their emotional state.
I think about how we can collaborate, build a network, or do business.
I notice their dressing sense, style, and how they present themselves.

questions.scenario: Your group project file gets deleted one night before submission. What is your instant reaction?

options.text: Don't panic, instantly draw a rough structure to recreate it fast.
Look for data recovery software or tech hacks to get it back.
Plan how to confidently explain the situation to the teacher to get extra time.
Calm down the other group members so nobody panics.

questions.scenario: The school introduces a rule that is very unfair. How do you handle it?

options.text: Organize students, run a signature campaign, and protest logically.
Check the legal aspects and school constitution to see if it's allowed.
Find a smart loophole or tech trick to bypass the rule safely.
Think about how this rule will negatively affect the weaker students' mental health.

questions.scenario: When you are given a massive, 100-page book to read in two days, what is your strategy?

options.text: Read the index, find the most important chapters, and skip the rest.
Divide the pages by hours and read it systematically like a machine.
Look for a video summary or an audio podcast about the book.
Form a group of 5 friends, read 20 pages each, and explain it to each other.

questions.scenario: During a school event, the main speaker's mic stops working. You are nearby. What do you do?

options.text: Jump in, check the cables, amplifier, and try to fix the tech issue.
Take another mic, engage the audience with a joke so they don't get bored.
Run to the backroom, coordinate with the tech team, and manage the chaos.
Observe the speaker to see if they are getting anxious and try to calm them.

questions.scenario: You have to launch a new brand. Which part of the process excites you the most?

options.text: Designing the logo, packaging, and the beautiful website.
Writing the script for the ad film and shooting the video.
Setting up the delivery trucks and warehouses across India.
Meeting investors and calculating the profit margins.

questions.scenario: You visit a completely new city. What catches your eye first?

options.text: The energy, vibe, and historical/spiritual places.
The roads, bridges, drainage, and how the buildings are made.
The culture of the people and what facilities they lack.
Empty market spaces where a new startup could be opened.

questions.scenario: If you watched a movie 6 months ago, what do you remember the most today?

options.text: The exact dialogues, character names, and facts.
The beautiful camera angles, lighting, and locations.
The logical timeline and plot twists of the story.
The background music and the emotions I felt.

questions.scenario: You have to memorize a 2-page speech. What is your fastest way to learn it?

options.text: I read it silently multiple times until it fits in my brain.
I highlight it with different colors and remember the visual shape of the paragraphs.
I break it into logical bullet points and understand the flow.
I speak it out loud while walking around the room.

questions.scenario: When learning a complex science topic, what helps you understand it best?

options.text: A detailed 3D animation or diagram.
A teacher explaining it with a real-life story.
Doing the experiment myself with my own hands.
Reading the textbook definition and solving the formula.

questions.scenario: You lost your house keys. How does your brain try to find them?

options.text: I close my eyes and visualize my exact movements like a CCTV camera.
I logically trace my steps backward (If I opened the fridge, keys must be near it).
I just start searching everywhere physically without overthinking.
I ask everyone in the house if they saw it.

questions.scenario: How do you prefer to remember a person you met briefly?

options.text: Their exact name and profession.
Their face and the clothes they were wearing.
The interesting concept or idea we discussed.
The 'vibe' they gave off (whether they were arrogant or sweet).

questions.scenario: You have to work for 8 hours continuously. Which environment would you prefer?

options.text: Roaming around the city, meeting people, or organizing an outdoor event.
Sitting on a comfortable chair, fully focused on a laptop or books.
Working with my hands—fixing machines, crafting, or doing surgery.
Standing on a stage, speaking, and interacting with a crowd.

questions.scenario: After a very tiring week, how does your body demand rest?

options.text: Playing an intense sport or hitting the gym to sweat the stress out.
Sleeping for 10 hours or reading a book in silence.
Going out on a long drive or a trek in nature.
Gaming, watching anime, or painting.

questions.scenario: You get a massive piece of empty land. What do you physically build there?

options.text: An organic farm with smart greenhouse technology.
An eco-friendly resort for tourists from all over the world.
A wildlife conservation zone to protect nature.
A modern sports complex with state-of-the-art facilities.

questions.scenario: What is your relationship with 'Fine Motor Skills' (using your hands perfectly)?

options.text: I am great at drawing, painting, or playing musical instruments.
I type extremely fast on keyboards without looking.
I can open gadgets with a screwdriver and fix them easily.
I prefer using my whole body (sports, dancing) rather than intricate finger work.

questions.scenario: When there is extreme chaos, loud noise, and pressure around you, what happens to your body?

options.text: My adrenaline pumps up and I perform my best in the chaos.
I put on noise-canceling headphones and isolate myself completely.
I start giving loud orders and take control of the crowd.
I observe everything silently before making a move.

questions.scenario: If you had to order something on Blinkit/Amazon, what fascinates you about the process?

options.text: How fast the delivery rider manages traffic physically.
The smooth UI/UX design of the app while ordering.
How the business tracks millions of orders without a crash.
If the delivery workers are getting fair wages and safety.
